description: Two fixed Ed25519 key pairs for the signing vectors (W4.3, docs/decisions.md 2026-10-05, point 6): RFC 8032 section 7.1's tests 1 and 2. They are published test keys, known to everyone, and must never sign anything real. `seed_hex` is the RFC's 32-byte SECRET KEY; `private_pkcs8_base64` is the key as the Worker's RP_SIGNING_KEY_BASE64 carries it (standard Base64 of the 48-byte PKCS#8 DER: the 16 bytes 302e020100300506032b657004220420, then the seed); `public_key_pem` is the SubjectPublicKeyInfo PEM a verifier is given (LF line ends); `key_id` is the SHA-256 of that key's SubjectPublicKeyInfo DER, 64 lower-case hex. bundle.json and cases.json name a key by its `name`.
